mr_title: Handle --version eagerly to avoid loading the entire infrastructure
mr_description:
Currently, handling `--version` in `pytest_cmdline_main` requires loading the entire infrastructure, which can be slow depending on the installed plugins.

This change introduces a marginal behavioral difference, though it should not cause any issues in practice.

expected_issues.title: Early version handling ignores the -V short option
expected_issues.description:
The early exit only recognises the long '--version' flag; the documented short alias '-V' now falls through to code paths that no longer print the version.

Version handling moved from helpconfig to an early check in main(), and the later fallbacks were rewritten around `--version`. `pytest -V` is an alias of `--version` but is not counted by `new_args.count("--version")`, so `pytest -V` no longer shows the version information. Both spellings must be handled (e.g. count('--version') + count('-V') == 1).
